questions.questionText: Which statements describe some enzyme actions?

Lipase is an enzyme that catalyses the hydrolysis of lipids. An experiment was carried out to investigate changes in pH when lipase is added to a food sample containing a high proportion of lipids. The results are shown in the graph. pH of food 7 sample 0 5 10 15 20 25 30 35 40 45 50 55 60 time / minutes Which statements are possible explanations of the results of the experiment between 50 minutes and 60 minutes?

The painkiller ibuprofen reduces the activity of an enzyme involved in the production of prostaglandin. Ibuprofen binds reversibly to the active site of the enzyme. Which type of enzyme inhibition describes this example and why?

options.A: competitive inhibition because ibuprofen alters the shape of the enzyme
options.B: competitive inhibition because ibuprofen and the substrate cannot bind at the same time
options.C: non-competitive inhibition because ibuprofen blocks the active site

questions.questionText: During the cell cycle, the mass of DNA in a cell is doubled. At which stage in the cell cycle is the mass of DNA in a cell reduced?

options.A: anaphase

questions.questionText: How many of the listed structures typically contain genetic material that has telomeres?  bacterial cell  chloroplast  mitochondrion  nucleus

options.A: 1 B 2 C 3 D 4

questions.questionText: In eukaryotes, the chromosomes become shorter and thicker during mitosis. The thickening may be increased by molecules called protamines. The protamines replace part of the structure of the chromosome. Which part of the chromosome is replaced by protamines?

options.A: centromeres

options.C: a sequence of bases that forms part of an RNA molecule and codes for a protein
options.D: a sequence of nucleotides that forms part of an RNA molecule and codes for a polypeptide

questions.questionText: Why is the mammalian circulatory system described as a double circulation?

options.D: Blood transports both oxygen and carbon dioxide.

questions.questionText: A graft of tissue, such as skin, from a different person is usually rejected by the body. Which statement about graft rejection is correct?

options.A: The graft is rejected by B-lymphocytes because they make and release antibodies which react with the surface antigens on the graft cells.
options.B: The graft is rejected by B-lymphocytes because T-lymphocytes are not stimulated to produce antibodies.
options.C: The graft is rejected by T-lymphocytes because the graft tissue causes T-lymphocytes to release antibodies.
